headline: BLB Limited appoints M/s MAPSS and Company as internal auditors
hook: New internal auditor appointed for FY27
summary: BLB Limited has appointed M/s MAPSS and Company, Chartered Accountants, as the internal auditors of the company effective November 4, 2026. The appointment is for the financial year 2026-27 to oversee internal audit processes. For an Indian retail investor, this is a routine corporate governance filing with no immediate impact on share price or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update, no direct financial impact for shareholders.

headline: BLB Limited announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Board meets to review corporate proceedings
summary: BLB Limited informed the stock exchanges about the conclusion of its board of directors meeting held on November 4, 2026. The filing represents a standard regulatory disclosure by the company. Such procedural updates carry no immediate financial impact for retail shareholders. Investors should review official exchange filings for detailed agenda resolutions.
whats_next: Detailed financial or corporate announcements if any
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact on retail holdings.
